title: Sufficiebat nobis paupertas (Jachet)
desc: Jachet of Mantua, Sufficiebat nobis paupertas. 5 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus I, Bassus II), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
